propositions: Define a language-agnostic Analyzer protocol plus AnalyzerResult with optional loc/complexity/duplication fields defaulting to None when unsupported.
Provide a per-language selection helper resolve_analyzer(lang) that returns None when no analyzer is configured, replacing hardcoded path scanning by metric readers.
The fallback helper must reuse the existing Unavailable(reason, accruing_since) sentinel and never invent a single-arg Unavailable, scan a path, fabricate zeros, or leak an exception string.
Avoid naming the concept registry/REGISTRY to prevent collision with metrics/registry.py; use an ANALYZERS map instead.
New analyzer adapters belong in a new src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/ package, not the quarantined adapters/ directory.
Ship pure stdlib with no import side effects that register anything into REGISTRY; wiring is opt-in in a later ticket.
